Theme

Africa took over the agenda

Africa went from 0% of resolutions in the founding era to 52% in 2011 to 2021.

The map of crises moved with history: Asia and Palestine in the founding years, decolonisation and Cyprus in the 1960s, the Middle East and Southern Africa in the late Cold War, the Balkans in the 1990s, then Africa's civil wars. Europe has almost left the adopted texts, partly because of the veto: Ukraine appears in the vetoed drafts.
